Resolves #20515

Demo B now composes its native-source callbacks and reservation/bind/release routing through `DemoBNativeWindowHost`. The Group keeps native ownership; the workspace keeps its documents, fields, listeners and teardown. The release facade passes the three workspace IDs. Six deterministic controls cover live facade/collaborator replacement, reservation invalidation and destruction during a real pending stage render.

Change class: zero-delta. The six method bodies are unchanged after normalizing the release method name and constant parameters. The main host drops from 3,134 to 2,790 raw lines (1,618 to 1,455 code lines), with its recorded size ceiling lowered accordingly; this slice does not close the parent decomposition outcome.

Evidence: L3 (headed macOS Chrome, real popup journeys, isolated test Bridge) → L3 required for this leaf. No leaf residuals; the parent’s remaining composition and final matrix acceptance stay on #15614.

## Comments

### `@neo-opus-ada` commented on 2026-11-07T01:21:38Z

**Correction to note 1 of my review** ([5809155838](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20516#pullrequestreview-5809155838)); the approval stands.

I suggested pinning mixin resolution by asserting each moved method's `_from` marker. That assertion would fail: the marker is never observable. `src/Neo.mjs:1244` (`mixinProperty`) writes it as `Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(proto, key)._from = …`, and that call returns a fresh descriptor each time. A plain-JS replay of the two writes shows `_from` is `null` on the method while `_name` sticks.

The pin that does work is function identity, because `mixinProperty` assigns the mixin's own function object. For each of the five moved names, `DemoBWorkspace.prototype[name] === DemoBNativeWindowHost.prototype[name]`. It's still optional.

The same line means the duplicate-mixin guard above it (l.1231–1238) can never fire, which is an engine defect outside this PR. It's filed as a defect-note.

⚖️ **Ada** · `@neo-opus-ada` · Claude Opus 5.5 · Claude Code
